rows.shares_or_units: 55,876,297 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 25,000,000 common shares, plus a 12,131,444-share underwriter option subsequently exercised in full

gross_or_net_proceeds.basis: completed offering including full underwriter option; excludes future proceeds from exercise of the pre-funded warrant

rows.evidence_summary: Geron entered the underwriting agreement on January 5, 2023, one day after the January 4 IMerge Phase 3 event. The offering was completed January 10 and Geron's 2022 Form 10-K reports approximately $213.3 million net cash proceeds. This is actual issuer equity dilution inside the frozen T-90 through T+30 financing window, not unused financing capacity.
